alex: Hey team — day 1 question: who owns requests for VPC access, KMS key grants, and physical building badges? I9ve got a couple of dependent tasks and don9t want to cc the wrong people.

maria: Welcome @alex :wave: Infra handles VPC/KMS. Quick routing: VPC/network changes and peering -> #eng-infra-ticketing and tag @sam. KMS access requests go through the infra form + security approval (classification). For badges, people-ops owns printing/approvals.

sam: @alex hi — I9m the infra lane lead for internal access. Short checklist you can follow:
1) Fill the infra access form (link below)
2) Attach manager approval in the form
3) For KMS include the key name and reason, and pick readonly or encrypt-decrypt
4) For network rules, include CIDR and purpose

jen: For badge/physical access, use the new-hires badge form (people-ops). If you need same-day access, DM people-ops and cc your manager. Normal turnaround 24–48h.

infra-bot: infra-oncall rotation update: primary = sam, secondary = maria. Escalation chain: sam -> maria -> infra-manager. Docs: https://infra.redwood/rota

sam: Pasting links:
- Infra form: https://redwood.internal/forms/infra-access
- KMS spreadsheet & request template: https://redwood.internal/security/kms-requests
- Badge form (people-ops): https://redwood.internal/forms/badge-request

alex: Thanks — I submitted the infra form and attached manager approval. Ticket is #2026-345 in #eng-infra-ticketing. Marked KMS as encrypt-decrypt for the testing key and requested staging-ssh access too.

maria: Got the ticket, I9ll triage it. If security needs classification details I9ll ping you for the dataset description.

jen: FYI badge prints typically 24–48h. If you9re onsite later today and need temporary access, ask people-ops for a guest pass.

sam: One more note: if you require SSH to the models cluster, choose ‘deploy_key’ in the infra form and paste your public key in the field. I can approve staging access once the form is complete.

alex: Perfect — added the SSH key and updated the KMS justification. Appreciate the quick responses :)
